<entry id="H01527">
<head-word>חֲצִיצָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (חָצַץ I) 
<italic>interposition, an intervening object</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Kam. 82
<sup>a</sup> bot. משום ח' to prevent an interposition (to remove anything sticking to the body or in the hair before bathing). Zeb. 19
<sup>a</sup> ותיפוק ליה משום ח' ought it not to be forbidden as an unlawful interposition between the priest’s hand and the object he has to handle?; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲצִיצִין</plural-form>
<italic>the laws concerning interpositions</italic>. Erub. 4
<sup>a</sup>; Succ. 5
<sup>b</sup></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01531">
<head-word>חָצַף</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. חָסַף a. P. Sm. 1353 חצפא = ch. חספא) 
<italic>to peel off, bare;</italic> part. pass.</definition>
<notes> חָצוּף (sub. אפיים); f. חֲצוּפָה </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>barefaced, impudent, arrogant</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 3
<sup>a</sup> ב"ד ח' an arrogant court (two sitting in judgment instead of three). Y. Taan. III, 66
<sup>d</sup> top אחת ח' ואחת כשירה one was unabashed, the other chaste. Ned. 20
<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>undaunted, energetic, strong</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Vayera 23 הנפש ח' היא the instinct of life is strong. Ex. R. s. 42 ג' חֲצוּפִים הם ח' בחיה וכ' (Bets. 25
<sup>b</sup> עז) three (creatures) are persevering (undaunted by failure or opposition), among beasts it is the dog &c. Y. Taan. IV, 69
<sup>b</sup> מה חציפה וכ' (read: חצו') how irrepressible is the Land of Israel that it still is productive (after all devastations).—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲצוּפִים,</plural-form> f. חֲצוּפוֹת. Ex. R. l. c., v. supra.—Y. Ber. V, 8
<sup>d</sup> bot. שעות הח' וכ' those irresistible, hard and evil times.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הֶחֱצִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to bare</italic> (one’s face), 
<italic>to act irreverently</italic>.</definition>
<notes>
<pgbrk id="pg496" />Koh. R. to IX, 18 כל המַחֲצִיף פניו וכ' whoever speaks irreverently of &c. Ib. III, 9 מַחֲצִיפִין אתם you embolden yourselves.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="H01534">
<head-word>חָצַץ, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to cut off, divide; to line a wall so as to leave a space</italic> (חָצָץ) 
<italic>between the two partitions.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ohol. XV, 4 בית שחֲצָצוֹ וכ' a room which one partitioned off with boards or tapestry on the sides (walls) or on the ceiling. Ib. 5 ח' מארצו if he partitioned it off from the floor (laying an additional floor with a vacuum between); Tosef. ib. XV, 4.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="H01544">
<head-word>חָצֵר</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. 
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="H01542">חצר</xref>, 
<xref rid="unknown">v. preced.</xref></language-reference> wds.</definition>
<notes>; cmp. גָּזַר a. גִּזְרָה &c.) 
<italic>court, yard</italic>, in gen. 
<italic>private property</italic>. B. Mets. 11
<sup>a</sup> חֲצֵרוֹ של אדם וכ' the ground belonging to a person takes possession for him (of what is found there) even without his knowledge. Ib. ח' המשתמרת a well-guarded ground (fenced-in). B. Kam. 12
<sup>a</sup>; Gitt. 21
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. ח' מהלכת a moving ground, e.g. the back of a slave. Erub. VI, 1 הדר עם … בח' if one dwells in the same court yard with a gentile. Ib. 3 אנשי ח' the residents of dwellings in one court yard; a. v. fr.—ח' הצירית Tyrian yard (with a lodge at the entrance). Maasr. III, 5; Nidd. 47
<sup>b</sup>.—חֲצַר הקבר the excavated ground to which all the caves of a cemetery open. Ohol. XV, 8; Tosef. ib. XV, 7.—חֲ' הכירה 
<italic>the rim</italic> of the cooking range. Kel. VII, 3; Tosef. ib. B. Kam. V, 5.—חֲ' הכבד (= b. h. יֹתֶרֶת) 
<italic>lobe</italic> of the liver. Yoma VIII, 6; a. e.—חֲ' מות 
<italic>cemetery</italic>, v. supra. Ber. 18
<sup>b</sup>.—
<plural-form>Pl. חֲצֵרוֹת, חֲצֵי'</plural-form>. Erub. IV, 6. Ib. VI, 8; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
